description: Application view model for user sub areas data (not stored as a database table), linked to sub area, users.
business_purpose: Used to track and report user sub areas records for the Branch & Geography area.
record_granularity: One object represents one user sub area result row.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the user sub area.

columns.name: userId
columns.description: Reference to the users linked to this user sub area.

columns.name: sub_areaId
columns.description: Reference to the sub area linked to this user sub area.

relationships.description: Each user sub area references one users (user).
Each user sub area references one sub area (sub area).

business_rules: Join to Sub Area, Users through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
UserSubAreas is an application view model or report DTO populated in code, not a table stored in the database.
common_queries: User Sub Areas by sub area

query_notes: Do not generate SQL against UserSubAreas: no table or view with this name exists in the connected database.
Use COUNT(DISTINCT id) when counting user sub area records; joins can duplicate rows.
To resolve names, join on: userId = Users.Id; sub_areaId = SubArea.id.
Populated in application code (for example from a stored procedure or joined query); query the underlying tables instead.
